title: Safe Tool Specification 1.0
description: JSON Schema for a Safe Tool Spec document. See https://spring-ai-community.github.io/spring-ai-playground/safe-tool-specification/ for the full normative text.

toolId.description: Stable identifier - UUID v5 derived from `name` against a fixed namespace is the reference scheme.

name.description: MCP tool name. Slug-like (alphanumeric + - + _) recommended; consumers MUST NOT reject non-empty strings on slug grounds alone.

description.description: Model-visible tool description. Drives tool selection.

category.description: UI grouping. The bundled catalog uses WEB / FILE / CRYPTO / DATETIME / TEXT / ENCODING / DATA / SECURITY / MATH / NETWORK / SYSTEM / UTILS / OTHER; private specs MAY introduce new categories.

tags.description: Cohort labels (max 2). Bundled vocab: korea, example, util, pipeline, github, search, finance, weather, geo.

staticVariables.description: Ordered single-entry objects; values MAY embed ${ENV_VAR} placeholders (regex \$\{([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)}).

code.description: JavaScript action body executed in a sandboxed GraalVM Polyglot Context.

codeType.description: Code language. Only `Javascript` is accepted in v1.

humanInTheLoop.description: Per-tool human approval policy. Absent or null = DISABLED (no approval). See Section 10.7.

mode.description: DISABLED = run without asking; REQUIRED = ask on every call.

promptTemplate.description: Optional approval-prompt text. {toolName} and {args} are substituted at call time. Null = default prompt.

draft.description: True until the spec earns a Local Pass; drafts MUST NOT be exposed via MCP.

name.description: Argument name in the model's tool call payload.

required.description: If true, runtime refuses execution without this argument.

testValue.description: Sample value the Local Pass runs with. REQUIRED when `required` is true.

JsonSchemaType.description: Uppercase on the wire in the spec document; lowered to JSON Schema's spelling when emitted to a model.

SandboxOverrides.description: Author-stated intent. Missing or null fields mean baseline; explicit values override.

networkMode.description: Resolved at posture-computation time. Null inherits baseline.

hostsAllow.description: Egress allow list when networkMode is `allowlist`. `["*"]` is the wildcard sentinel (treated as L4).

fileRead.description: Tri-state: null inherits, true allows, false explicitly blocks.

fileWrite.description: Tri-state: null inherits, true allows, false explicitly blocks.

fsBasePath.description: Override the default safety.fs/v1 base path. Null inherits.

destructive.description: Flags a tool that removes or relocates data (delete, move, recursive dir removal). True scores Risk Level L5. Absent/null/false means not destructive.

ToolSafety.description: Resolver-produced posture snapshot. Recorded into the audit log on every invocation.

version.description: Spec-schema version this block was written against, e.g. "1.0".

helpers.description: Versioned helper identifiers. Two shapes are accepted: namespaced (e.g. "safety.fs/v1", "safety.http/v1", "safety.parser/v1") and anchor-suffixed (e.g. "tool-safety-helpers/v1#crypto", "tool-safety-helpers/v1#encoding", "tool-safety-helpers/v1#parser").
